1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 45 cm de longitud, de color azulado, pardusco o negruzco, con el vientre plateado, cuerpo lateralmente comprimido, mandíbula inferior prominente y base de la aleta caudal sin escamas; es comestible. (Clupeidae, Clupea harengus).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 45 cm in length, with a bluish, brownish or black coloration, and a silvery belly; its body is laterally compressed, the lower jaw is prominent, and the base of the caudal fin is scaleless; it is edible. (Clupeidae, Clupea harengus).
